subject: Cloud Computing
title: Foundation Models and Cloud Marketplaces
description: A fast breakdown of Foundation Models and Cloud Marketplaces for builders.

hook.text: AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, and Google Vertex AI let you access GPT-4, Claude, and Llama through your cloud account.

buildup.text: Foundation models are general-purpose AI models that can be fine-tuned for specific tasks. Cloud provides the platform.

discovery.text: Model marketplaces let you compare models, switch providers, and run them within your security perimeter.

twist.text: Cloud provider competition now centers on AI model access. Whoever has the best models wins cloud customers.

climax.text: Foundation models are reshaping cloud strategy. Cloud is no longer just infrastructure — it's the AI model marketplace.

punchline.text: Cloud providers sell AI models now. Infrastructure is just the platform.

quiz.question: How are foundation models changing cloud competition?
options: Cloud providers compete on AI model access, not just infrastructure and pricing
Foundation models have made cloud computing obsolete
Only one cloud provider is allowed to offer foundation models

details.summary: Cloud marketplaces now offer foundation models from providers like Anthropic, Meta, and Mistral alongside traditional software. Organizations can access, fine-tune, and deploy large language models through their existing cloud infrastructure without managing model hosting infrastructure.
details.whyItMatters: Model marketplaces accelerate AI adoption by providing one-click access to foundation models within secure cloud environments. They make state-of-the-art AI accessible without specialized infrastructure knowledge.
takeaways: Cloud marketplaces now offer foundation models for direct use
Fine-tuning and deployment happen within existing cloud environments
Organizations avoid managing complex model hosting infrastructure

faq.question: What is AWS Bedrock?
faq.answer: AWS Bedrock provides access to foundation models from Anthropic, Meta, Mistral, and others through a unified API. It handles model hosting, scaling, and security. Customers can fine-tune models with their own data while keeping data private within their AWS account.

faq.question: Why use a cloud marketplace for AI models?
faq.answer: Cloud marketplaces handle the infrastructure complexity of hosting large models, provide enterprise security and compliance, consolidate billing, and offer unified APIs across multiple model providers. This lets organizations experiment with different models without separate hosting setups.
